newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shell Electric raises funds for R&D.
newsitem.headline: Shell Electric raises funds for R&D.

text.p: Shell Electric Mfg (Holdings) Company Ltd said on Friday it would place new shares in the company to raise funds for product development programmes.
The company said in a statement that CEF Capital Ltd had agreed to place 70 million shares in the company, 55 million on a guaranteed basis and 15 million on a best efforts basis.
The placement is to be completed on or before November 26.

Net proceeds from the new issue totalling HK$374 million -- assuming all 70 million are successfully placed -- would be applied to new group product development projects and marketing and promotion programmes for those new products, the company said.
The placement price is HK$5.50 per share, and represents a 8.03 percent discount to the average closing price on the five trading days (including November 20) prior to the suspension.

Directors of the company will initially place out existing shares, then issue 70 million new shares. The shares represent 19.04 percent of the existing issued capital and 15.99 percent of the enlarged issued capital of the company.
Following the issue of the new shares, the holding of major shareholder Yung Yau and family will be reduced from 45.79 percent to 38.46 percent of the enlarged issued capital.
Trading in the shares, which was suspended on Thursday, will resume on Friday.
